description: Prepare (never sign or send) the two transactions a buyer wallet must submit to hire a service: 1) stablecoin approve (USDC on Base), 2) createAndFundOrder on the escrow. Non-custodial: this server holds no keys. Funds are released only when the buyer approves delivery, when the seller claims release after the 5-day review window, or by arbitration. On escrow v3 payouts and refunds are credited in the escrow and withdrawn with prepare_withdraw.

buyerWallet.description: Address of the wallet that will fund the escrow

chainId.description: 8453 Base Mainnet (default) or 84532 Base Sepolia with free test USDC
